title: DOFFO_TR: a Decentralized Objective Function-Free Optimization method with Trust-Region
summary: In this paper, we propose a novel objective function-free trust-region method designed to solve optimization problems over decentralized networks. Unlike traditional approaches that often rely on stepsize tuning, our framework employs a function-free trust-region procedure that enables adaptive selection of the step length. Our approach accommodates first- and second-order models and eliminates the need to share local function values and gradients among agents, thereby enhancing privacy and computational efficiency.
